messages:
Aisha: Dropping a short live thread after today's all-hands for any follow-ups about mission, market positioning, and competitive claims. Keep Qs tight and we'll answer.
Tao: Quick — how should sales frame our advantage vs big cloud vendors who now offer managed LLM endpoints?
Aisha: Emphasize outcomes: customers choose us when they need predictable production economics + fast ops (rollouts, model pinning). Clouds offer scale; we offer inference that actually fits production SLAs and cost targets.
Marco: Tech line to add: "We pick kernels, route by policy, and apply prefix/KV caching automatically so you see lower p95s and reduced token spend in practice." Don't over-quantify for hosted.
Maya: Are we explicitly calling out model governance and private deployments in marketing? Some prospects ask about on-prem.
Elena: Yes. Two tracks: public messaging = hosted + dedicated; enterprise collateral = private deployment, KMS/HSM, audit logs. Keep them separate so dev-facing pages stay simple.
Priya: Competitors keep spotlighting price cuts. Do we respond publicly with a price comparison or a TCO narrative?
Aisha: TCO narrative. Show real examples where batching, caching, and autoscaling cut monthly spend vs headline per-token numbers.
Marco: Also point out time-to-live: customers save engineering hours by using our curated model variants and rollout controls.
Tao: For pitch decks, any one-liner we can use that is accurate?
Elena: Use: "Predictable inference economics and deployment controls for production ML apps." Then pick a supporting fact for the buyer.
Maya: Roadmap ask: should infra prioritize more kernel/latency work or feature work like rollouts and per-route observability next quarter?
Aisha: Short: balance both. Priority order is 1) runtime/kernel wins to reduce churn, 2) rollout/observability to close enterprise, 3) cost tooling (quantization guidance). Some work will run in parallel.
Marco: Engineering note: follow-on sprint for canary/fallback is scheduled; example config being validated: `rollout: {canary:0.05, monitor:p95_latency, fallback:smaller-variant}`.
Tao: Helpful. Will mirror in Solutions templates.
ops-bot: docs.redwood.ai/playbooks/tco-and-rollouts shared :link:
Priya: I'll draft two concise hooks (dev-focused, infra-focused) and a one-slide cheat sheet for Sales today.
Aisha: Thanks everyone  I'll close this thread in 24h unless more Qs come in. Keep replies short.
